pick.name: Fontsource (Google Fonts, self-hosted via npm)
pick.what: Every Google Font (and more) as versioned npm packages
pick.why: Self-hosting avoids Google Fonts CDN privacy issues (GDPR), works offline in desktop/mobile builds, licence per package.

alts.name: Google Fonts (CDN)
alts.why: Simplest for marketing pages; EU users raise privacy objections to the CDN.

alts.name: Fontshare (ITF)
alts.what: Free premium-quality display fonts (Satoshi, General Sans...)
alts.why: More distinctive brand faces; web OK, app embedding needs a paid ITF licence (unconfirmed).

decision: Fontsource gives you Google Fonts' OFL catalogue as code dependencies, so Claude Code can wire fonts identically in web, desktop and mobile. Use a Fontshare face only on the web until its app-embedding terms are confirmed.
details: For non-Latin scripts (Devanagari, Arabic, CJK and others) pair the Latin face with the matching Noto family (OFL).
